selection_rationale: Direction-controlled displacement round on 48 fresh compact-16 mothers (smallest-seed rule, outcome-blind). Two magnitudes with four directions each (2.24: (2,1),(1,-2),(-2,-1),(-1,2); 17.72: (5,-17),(17,5),(-5,17),(-17,-5), the first being torus-equivalent to the previous (5,31)) plus the 23.77 point (23,42) for the magnitude curve. Primary pre-registered prediction (see preregistered_direction_predictions.json, written before these runs): the interface-resource change dB(d) = boundary_c_mean(shifted) - boundary_c_mean(original) predicts the paired fate response with Spearman(dB, delta_q_B) < 0 across mother-direction pairs; direction-dependence at fixed magnitude and the magnitude turnover are secondary. No uniform arms: total-matched decomposition was settled in the previous round.
interpretation: fate endpoints for direction-controlled displacement vectors; mother-level paired analysis against the same mothers' original arm
